videos.title: LightconePod AI agent infrastructure
videos.searchText:
lightconepod ai agent infrastructure lightconepod ai agent infrastructure y combinator over the past year, we've been building our own internal agent infrastructure at yc: over 350 tools, self-improving skill loops, and a shared organizational brain that gets smarter overnight.

conductor fireside conductor fireside y combinator conductor (@conductor_build) is a mac app that lets you run multiple coding agents at the same time. create an isolated copy of your codebase in one click, tell claude or codex to go work, and review and merge the results.

detail.title: Conductor Fireside
detail.description:
Conductor (@conductor_build) is a Mac app that lets you run multiple coding agents at the same time. Create an isolated copy of your codebase in one click, tell Claude or Codex to go work, and review and merge the results.

The company just raised a $22 million Series A, and today is launching Conductor Cloud, which lets agents keep working even after you close your laptop.

In this episode of Founder Firesides, co-founders @charlieholtz and @jacksondecampos sat down with YC's @aaron_epstein to talk about cycling through a dozen ideas before landing on the one that stuck, how building dev tools for themselves led to Conductor, and what they've learned from watching the best engineers in the world work with coding agents every day.
